JPEG 2000 decoder (pure Nim, clean-room port). Technical reference: microsoft/jpeg2000_rs (MIT, (c) Microsoft Corporation) src/codestream/* (markers/layout/quantization/tiles), src/packet/, src/tier1/, src/transform/, src/jp2/. No standards text or test vectors are reproduced; only coding semantics re-expressed. HT VLC tables derive from OpenJPEG t1_ht_luts.h and retain their BSD-2 notices (see references THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES) alongside MIT. Scope: raw codestream (.j2k: SOC..EOC, single/multi tile, POC) + JP2 container (.jp2: signature/ftyp/jp2h/jp2c first-codestream) stills to DynamicImage. Reversible 5/3 + RCT and irreversible 9/7 (fixed-point); legacy and HTJ2K code-blocks incl. mixed routing; Part-15 CAP marker parsed and validated. Lossless output is pixel-exact vs opj/ojph; lossy matches ojph float output within +-1 per sample (fixed-point 9/7). Out of scope (clean Unsupported): JPX/JPH/JPIP, Part-2 general MCT/ MCO/NLT/CBD/decomposition selectors, subsampling, palettes, packed headers, tile-part coding overrides, palette execution beyond gray/RGB/RGBA mapping, animation, encode.

proc decodeJ2kRaw(data: openArray[uint8]): ImageResult[DynamicImage] {.
    ...raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Raw codestream decode: 5/3 reversible + RCT and 9/7 irreversible (legacy and HTJ2K code-blocks, including mixed legacy/HT), 1-4 comps, 8/16-bit, single/multi tile, all 5 progressions + POC (main or tile-part headers), SOP/EPH, bypass, RCT/ICT, JP2 color. Subsampling, palettes, packed headers and tile-part coding overrides are clean Unsupported (follow-up phases). 
proc decodeJp2(data: openArray[uint8]): ImageResult[DynamicImage] {....raises: [],
    tags: [], forbids: [].}
JP2 container decode: validate jp2h against the codestream SIZ (ihdr dims/comps, bpcc precisions), decode the first jp2c, apply color mapping (sYCC, alpha). Raw codestreams route straight through.
